title: Submit a notice of disposal for a vessel
summary: Learn how to notify Transport for NSW (TfNSW) about the sale of a vessel by submitting a notice of disposal.
intro: When you sell a vessel, you must notify Transport for NSW (TfNSW) within 14 days of the date of sale. You can do this online, or complete the notice of disposal on the back of the vessel's registration certificate and lodge it at a service centre or via the post.
who_can_apply: To submit your notice of disposal online, your email or mobile number must be on record with TfNSW.

how_to_steps.text: Read the information statement and select 'Start'.
Complete the online notice of disposal form.
visit a service centre and lodge the notice in person, or
post the documentation to:Agency Business CentrePO Box 21​Parkes NSW 2870

faqs.q: How long do I have to notify TfNSW about selling a vessel?
faqs.a: You must notify Transport for NSW (TfNSW) within 14 days of the date of sale.

faqs.q: How can I submit the notice of disposal?
faqs.a: You can submit the notice online, or complete the notice on the back of the vessel's registration certificate and lodge it at a service centre or via the post.
